paragraphs.sourceText: The Challenges for Artificial Intelligence in Agriculture
paragraphs.translationZh: 农业人工智能面临的挑战

paragraphs.sourceText: of an irrigation machine in central South Africa. The agronomist has just flown over the field with a hybrid unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) that takes off and lands using propellers yet maintains distance
paragraphs.translationZh: 南非中部的一台灌溉机。农艺师刚刚驾驶混合动力无人机 (UAV) 飞越田野，该无人机使用螺旋桨起飞和降落，但仍保持距离

paragraphs.sourceText: and speed for scanning vast hectares of land through the use of its fixed wings.
paragraphs.translationZh: 以及通过使用固定翼扫描大片土地的速度。

paragraphs.sourceText: B) The UAV is fitted with a four spectral band precision sensor that conducts onboard processing immediately after the flight, allowing farmers and field staff to address, almost immediately, any crop abnormalities that the sensor may have recorded, making the data collection truly real-time.
paragraphs.translationZh: B) 无人机配备了四光谱带精密传感器，在飞行后立即进行机载处理，使农民和田间工作人员几乎可以立即处理传感器可能记录的任何作物异常情况，使数据收集真正实时。

paragraphs.sourceText: C) In this instance, the farmers and agronomist are looking to specialized software to give them an accurate plant population count. It's been 10 days since the corn emerged and the farmer wants to determine if there are any parts of the field that require replanting due to a lack of emergence or wind damage, which can be severe in the early stages of the summer rainy season.
paragraphs.translationZh: C) 在这种情况下，农民和农学家正在寻求专门的软件来为他们提供准确的植物数量计数。玉米出苗已经 10 天了，农民想要确定田地中是否有任何部分因出苗不足或风害而需要重新种植，风害在夏季雨季初期可能会很严重。

paragraphs.sourceText: D) At this growth stage of the plant's development, the farmer has another 10 days to conduct any replanting before the majority of his fertilizer and chemical applications need to occur. Once these have been applied, it becomes economically unviable to take corrective action, making any further collected data historical and useful only to inform future practices for the season to come.
paragraphs.translationZh: D) 在植物发育的这个生长阶段，农民还有另外 10 天的时间进行重新种植，然后才需要进行大部分肥料和化学品施用。一旦应用了这些措施，采取纠正措施在经济上就变得不可行，使得任何进一步收集的数据都成为历史数据，并且只能为即将到来的赛季的未来实践提供信息。

paragraphs.sourceText: E) The software completes its processing in under 15 minutes producing a plant population count map. It's difficult to grasp just how impressive this is, without understanding that just over a year ago it would have taken three to five days to process the exact same data set, illustrating the advancements that have been achieved in precision agriculture and remote sensing in recent years. With the software having been developed in the United States on the same variety of crops in seemingly similar conditions, the agronomist feels confident that the software will produce a near accurate result.
paragraphs.translationZh: E) 软件在 15 分钟内完成处理，生成植物种群计数图。如果不了解一年多前处理完全相同的数据集需要三到五天的时间，就很难理解这是多么令人印象深刻，这说明了近年来精准农业和遥感领域取得的进步。由于该软件是在美国针对相同品种的作物在看似相似的条件下开发的，农学家相信该软件将产生近乎准确的结果。

paragraphs.sourceText: F) As the map appears on the screen, the agronomist's face begins to drop. Having walked through the planted rows before the flight to gain a physical understanding of the situation on the ground, he
paragraphs.translationZh: F) 当地图出现在屏幕上时，农艺师的脸开始垮下来。在飞行前，他走过了种植的行，以对地面的情况有一个实际的了解，他

paragraphs.sourceText: farmers, even with their limited understanding of _how to read remote sensing maps.
paragraphs.translationZh: 农民，即使他们对如何阅读遥感地图的了解有限。

paragraphs.sourceText: G) Hypothetically, it is possible for machines to learn to solve any problem on earth relating to the physical interaction of all things within a defined or contained environment by using artificial intelligence and machine learning.
paragraphs.translationZh: G) 假设，机器有可能通过使用人工智能和机器学习来学习解决地球上与定义或包含的环境中所有事物的物理交互有关的任何问题。

paragraphs.sourceText: H) Remote sensors enable algorithms (算法) to interpret a field's environment as statistical data that can be understood and useful to farmers for decision-making. Algorithms process the data, adapting and learning based on the data received. The more inputs and statistical information collected, the better the algorithm will be at predicting a range of outcomes. And the aim is that farmers cari use this artificial intelligence to achieve their goal of a better harvest through making better decisions in the field. D In 2011, IBM, through its R&D Headquarters in Haifa, Israel, launched an agricultural cloud­ computing project. The project, in collaboration with a number of specialized IT and agricultural partners, had one goal in mind-to take a variety of academic and physical data sources from an agricultural environment and tum these into automatic predictive solutions for farmers that would assist them in making real-time decisions in the field.
paragraphs.translationZh: H) 远程传感器使算法能够将田地环境解释为统计数据，农民可以理解这些数据并对其做出决策有用。算法处理数据，根据收到的数据进行调整和学习。收集的输入和统计信息越多，算法就越能更好地预测一系列结果。我们的目标是农民利用这种人工智能，通过在田间做出更好的决策来实现更好收成的目标。 D 2011年，IBM通过其位于以色列海法的研发总部启动了农业云计算项目。该项目与许多专业 IT 和农业合作伙伴合作，有一个目标：从农业环境中获取各种学术和物理数据源，并将这些数据转化为农民的自动预测解决方案，帮助他们在田间做出实时决策。

paragraphs.sourceText: J) Interviews with some of the IBM project team members at the time revealed that the team believed it was entirely possible to "algorithm" agriculture, meaning that algorithms could solve any problem in the world. Earlier that year, IBM's cognitive learning system, Watson, competed in the game Jeopardy against former winners Brad Rutter and Ken Jennings with astonishing results. Several years
paragraphs.translationZh: J) 当时对 IBM 项目团队的一些成员的采访显示，团队认为“算法”农业是完全可能的，也就是说算法可以解决世界上的任何问题。那年早些时候，IBM 的认知学习系统 Watson 在 Jeopardy 游戏中与前冠军 Brad Rutter 和 Ken Jennings 展开竞争，取得了惊人的成绩。几年

paragraphs.sourceText: later, Watson went on to produce ground-breaking achievements in the field of medicine.
paragraphs.translationZh: 后来，沃森继续在医学领域取得突破性的成就。

paragraphs.sourceText: K) So why did the project have such success in medicine but not agriculture? Because it is one of the most difficult fields to contain for the purpose of statistical quantification. Even within a single field, conditions are always changing from one section to the next. There's unpredictable weather, changes in soil quality, and the ever-present possibility that pests and diseases may pay a visit. Growers may feel their prospects are good for an upcoming harvest, but until that day arrives, the outcome will always be uncertain.
paragraphs.translationZh: K) 那么为什么该项目在医学上取得了如此成功，但在农业上却没有呢？因为它是统计量化中最难包含的字段之一。即使在单个领域内，条件也总是从一个部分到下一个部分而变化。天气难以预测，土壤质量发生变化，病虫害也随时可能出现。种植者可能认为即将到来的收成前景良好，但在那一天到来之前，结果总是不确定的。

paragraphs.sourceText: L) By comparison, our bodies are a contained environment. Agriculture takes place in nature, among ecosystems of interacting organisms and activity, and crop production takes place within that ecosystem environment. But these ecosystems are not contained. They are subject to climatic occurrences such as weather systems, which impact upon hemispheres as a whole, and from continent to continent. Therefore, understanding how to manage an agricultural environment means taking literally many hundreds if not thousands of factors into account.
paragraphs.translationZh: L) 相比之下，我们的身体是一个封闭的环境。农业发生在自然界中，在生物体和活动相互作用的生态系统中，作物生产发生在该生态系统环境中。但这些生态系统并未受到遏制。它们受到气候事件的影响，例如天气系统，影响整个半球以及各个大陆。因此，了解如何管理农业环境意味着要考虑数百甚至数千个因素。

paragraphs.sourceText: M) What may occur with the same seed and fertilizer program in the United States' Midwest region is almost certainly unrelated to what may occur with the same seed and fertilizer program in Australia or South Africa. A few factors that could impact on variation would typically include the measurement of rain per unit of a crop planted, soil type, patterns of soil degradation, daylight hours, temperature and so forth.
paragraphs.translationZh: M) 在美国中西部地区使用相同的种子和肥料计划可能发生的情况几乎肯定与在澳大利亚或南非使用相同的种子和肥料计划可能发生的情况无关。可能影响变化的一些因素通常包括单位种植作物的降雨量、土壤类型、土壤退化模式、日照时间、温度等。

paragraphs.sourceText: N) So the problem with deploying machine learning and artificial intelligence in agriculture is not that scientists lack the capacity to develop programs and protocols to begin to address the biggest of growers' concerns; the problem is that in most cases, no two environments will be exactly alike, which makes the testing, validation and successful rollout of such technologies much more laborious than in most other industries.
paragraphs.translationZh: N）因此，在农业中部署机器学习和人工智能的问题并不在于科学家缺乏开发程序和协议来开始解决种植者最大担忧的能力；而是在于科学家缺乏能力。问题是，在大多数情况下，没有两个环境是完全相同的，这使得此类技术的测试、验证和成功部署比大多数其他行业更加费力。

paragraphs.sourceText: 0) Practically, to say that AI and Machine Learning can be developed to solve all problems related to our
paragraphs.translationZh: 0）实际上，可以说人工智能和机器学习可以解决与我们相关的所有问题

paragraphs.sourceText: interaction of physical or material activity on the planet. After all, it is only through our understanding of 'the nature of things' that protocols and processes are designed for the rational capabilities of cognitive systems to take place. And, although AI and Machine Learning are teaching us many things about how to understand our environment, we are still far from being able to predict critical outcomes in fields like agriculture purely through the cognitive ability of machines. P) Backed by the venture capital community, which is now investing billions of dollars in the sector, most agricultural technology startups today are pushed to complete development as quickly as possible and then encouraged to flood the market as quickly as possible with their products. Q) This usually results in a failure of a product, which leads to skepticism from the market and delivers a blow to the integrity of Machine Leaming technology. In most cases, the problem is not that the technology does not work, the problem is that industry has not taken the time to respect that agriculture is one of the most uncontained environments to manage. For technology to truly make an impact on agriculture, more effort, skills, and funding is needed to test these technologies in farmers' fields. R) There is huge potential for artificial intelligence and machine learning to revolutionize agriculture by integrating these technologies into critical markets on a global scale. Only then can it make a difference to the grower, where it really counts.
paragraphs.translationZh: 地球上物理或物质活动的相互作用。毕竟，只有通过我们对“事物本质”的理解，协议和流程才能够实现认知系统的理性能力。而且，尽管人工智能和机器学习教会了我们许多关于如何理解我们的环境的知识，但我们还远远无法纯粹通过机器的认知能力来预测农业等领域的关键结果。 P）在风险投资界的支持下，目前在该领域投资了数十亿美元，当今大多数农业技术初创公司都被推动尽快完成开发，然后鼓励其产品尽快涌入市场。问）这通常会导致产品失败，从而引起市场的怀疑，并对机器学习技术的完整性造成打击。在大多数情况下，问题不在于技术不起作用，问题在于工业界没有花时间尊重农业是最难以管理的环境之一。为了使技术真正对农业产生影响，需要更多的努力、技能和资金来在农民的田间测试这些技术。 R) 通过将人工智能和机器学习整合到全球范围内的关键市场，人工智能和机器学习具有巨大的潜力来彻底改变农业。只有这样，它才能对种植者产生真正重要的影响。

paragraphs.sourceText: 36. Farmers will not profit from replanting once they have ·applied most of the · fertilizer and other chemicals to their fields.
paragraphs.translationZh: 36. 一旦农民在田地中使用了大部分化肥和其他化学品，他们就不会从重新种植中获利。

paragraphs.sourceText: 37. Agriculture differs from the medical science of the human body in that its environment is not a contained one.
paragraphs.translationZh: 37. 农业不同于人体医学，因为它的环境不是封闭的。

paragraphs.sourceText: 38. The agronomist is sure that he will obtain a near accurate count of plant population with his software.
paragraphs.translationZh: 38. 农学家确信他将使用他的软件获得近乎准确的植物种群计数。

paragraphs.sourceText: 39. The application of artificial intelligence to agriculture is much more challenging than to most other industries.
paragraphs.translationZh: 39. 人工智能在农业中的应用比大多数其他行业更具挑战性。

paragraphs.sourceText: 40. Even the farmers know the data provided by the UAV is not correct.
paragraphs.translationZh: 40.连农民都知道无人机提供的数据不正确。

paragraphs.sourceText: 41. The pressure for quick results leads to product failure, which, in turn, arouses doubts about the applicability of AI technology to agriculture.
paragraphs.translationZh: 41. 急功近利的压力导致产品失败，进而引发人们对人工智能技术在农业中的适用性的怀疑。

paragraphs.sourceText: 42. Remote sensors are aimed to help farmers improve decision-making to increase yields.
paragraphs.translationZh: 42. 遥感器旨在帮助农民改进决策以提高产量。

paragraphs.sourceText: 43. The farmer expects the software to tell him whether he will have to replant any parts of his farm fields.
paragraphs.translationZh: 43. 农民希望软件能够告诉他是否需要重新种植农田的任何部分。

paragraphs.sourceText: 44. Agriculture proves very difficult to quantify because of the constantly changing conditions involved.
paragraphs.translationZh: 44. 由于所涉条件不断变化，农业很难量化。

paragraphs.sourceText: 45. The same seed and fertilizer program may yield completely different outcomes in different places.
paragraphs.translationZh: 45. 相同的种子和肥料计划在不同的地方可能会产生完全不同的结果。

paragraphs.sourceText: What is the place of art in a culture of inattention? Recent visitors to the Louvre report that tourists can now spend only a minute in front of the Mona Lisa before being asked to move on. Much of that time, for some of them, is spent taking photographs not even of the painting but of themselves with the painting in the background.
paragraphs.translationZh: 在漫不经心的文化中，艺术的地位是什么？最近参观卢浮宫的游客报告说，游客现在只能在《蒙娜丽莎》前停留一分钟，然后就会被要求离开。对于他们中的一些人来说，大部分时间甚至不是花在为这幅画拍照，而是以这幅画为背景为自己拍照。

paragraphs.sourceText: One view is that we have democratised' tourism and gallery-going so much that we have made it effectively impossible to appreciate what we've travelled to see. In this oversubscribed society, experience becomes a commodity like any other. There are queues to climb Mt. Jolmo Lungma as well as to see famous paintings. Leisure, thus conceived, is hard labour, and returning to work becomes a well-eameq break from the ordeal.
paragraphs.translationZh: 一种观点认为，我们已经使旅游业和画廊参观变得如此民主化，以至于我们实际上无法欣赏我们所旅行的目的。在这个过度订阅的社会中，经验就像其他商品一​​样成为一种商品。登上珠穆朗玛峰以及观赏名画的人都排着长队。由此看来，休闲就是艰苦的劳动，而重返工作岗位则成为摆脱磨难的良好休息方式。

paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 51 to SS are based on the following passage.
paragraphs.translationZh: SS 的问题 51 基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: Every five years, the government tries to tell Americans what to put in their bellies. Eat more vegetables. Dial back the fats. It's all based on the best available science for leading a healthy life. But the best available science also has a lot to say about what those food choices do to the environment, and some researchers are annoyed that new dietary recommendations of the USDA ( United States Department of Agriculture) released yesterday seem to utterly ignore that fact.
paragraphs.translationZh: 每五年，政府都会尝试告诉美国人该吃什么。多吃蔬菜。减少脂肪。这一切都基于实现健康生活的最佳可用科学。但现有的最佳科学也对这些食物选择对环境的影响有很多说法，一些研究人员对美国农业部昨天发布的新饮食建议似乎完全忽视了这一事实感到恼火。

paragraphs.sourceText: Broadly, the 2016- 2020 dietary recommendations aim for balance: More vegetables, leaner meats and far less sugar.
paragraphs.translationZh: 总体而言，2016-2020 年饮食建议的目标是平衡：多吃蔬菜、少吃瘦肉、少吃糖。

paragraphs.sourceText: But Americans consume more calories per capita than almost any other country in the- world. So the things Americans eat have a huge impact on climate change. Soil tilling releases carbon dioxide, and delivery vehicles emit exhaust. The government's dietary guidelines could have done a lot to lower that climate cost. Not just because of their position of authority: The guidelines drive billions of dollars of food
paragraphs.translationZh: 但美国人人均消耗的卡路里比世界上几乎任何其他国家都多。所以美国人吃的东西对气候变化有巨大的影响。土壤耕作会释放二氧化碳，送货车辆会排放废气。政府的饮食指南本可以在降低气候成本方面发挥很大作用。不仅仅是因为他们的权威地位：这些指导方针推动了数十亿美元的粮食生产

paragraphs.sourceText: production through federal programs like school lunches and nutrition assistance for the needy.
paragraphs.translationZh: 通过学校午餐和贫困人口营养援助等联邦计划进行生产。

paragraphs.sourceText: On its own, plant and animal agriculture contributes 9 percent of all the country's greenhouse gas emissions. That's not counting the fuel burned in transportation, processing, refrigeration, and other waypoints between farm and belly. Red meats are among the biggest and most notorious emitters, but trucking a salad from California to Minnesota in January also carries a significant burden. And greenhouse gas emissions aren't the whole story. Food production is the largest user of fresh water, largest contributor to the loss of biodiversity, and a major contributor to using up natural resources.
paragraphs.translationZh: 动植物农业本身就占该国温室气体排放总量的 9%。这还不包括在运输、加工、冷藏以及农场和腹部之间的其他路径点燃烧的燃料。红肉是最大、最臭名昭著的排放源之一，但一月份用卡车将沙拉从加利福尼亚州运到明尼苏达州也带来了沉重的负担。温室气体排放并不是问题的全部。粮食生产是淡水的最大消耗者、生物多样性丧失的最大贡献者以及自然资源消耗的主要贡献者。

paragraphs.sourceText: All of these points and more showed up in the Dietary Guidelines Advisory Committee's scientific report, released last February. Miriam Nelson chaired the subcommittee in charge of sustainability for the report, and is disappointed that eating less meat and buying local food aren't in the final product. "Especially if you consider that eating less meat, especially red and processed, has health benefits," she says.
paragraphs.translationZh: 所有这些要点以及更多内容都出现在膳食指南咨询委员会去年二月发布的科学报告中。米里亚姆·尼尔森（Miriam Nelson）担任该报告负责可持续发展小组委员会的主席，她对最终产品中没有少吃肉和购买当地食品感到失望。 “特别是如果你认为少吃肉类，尤其是红肉和加工肉类，对健康有益，”她说。

paragraphs.sourceText: So what happened? The official response is that sustainability falls too far outside the guidelines' official scope, which is to provide "nutritional and dietary information."
paragraphs.translationZh: 那么发生了什么？官方回应是，可持续性远远超出了指南的官方范围，即提供“营养和饮食信息”。

paragraphs.sourceText: Possibly the agencies in charge of drafting the decisions are too close to the industries they are supposed to regulate. On one hand, the USDA is compiling dietary advice. On the other, their clients are US agriculture companies.
paragraphs.translationZh: 负责起草决定的机构可能与他们本应监管的行业过于接近。一方面，美国农业部正在编制饮食建议。另一方面，他们的客户是美国农业公司。

paragraphs.sourceText: The line about keeping the guidelines' scope to nutrition and diet doesn't ring quite right with researchers. David Wallinga, for example, says, "In previous guidelines, they've always been concerned with things like food security-which is presumably the mission of the USDA. You absolutely need to be
paragraphs.translationZh: 研究人员认为，关于将指南的范围限制在营养和饮食方面的说法并不完全正确。例如，大卫·沃林加 (David Wallinga) 表示：“在之前的指导方针中，他们一直关注食品安全等问题，这可能是美国农业部的使命。你绝对需要

paragraphs.sourceText: worried about climate impacts and future sustainability if you want secure food in the future."
paragraphs.translationZh: 如果你想要未来有安全的食物，就要担心气候影响和未来的可持续性。”
